title: Curtain Intro
summary: A full-screen curtain holds briefly, then wipes upward to reveal the page.
useWhen: loading screen for a restaurant site with a short intro

whyItWorks.how: The curtain is revealed away through a clip-path inset rather than sliding across the page.
A 600ms hold and a 700ms wipe sit in the page-level 400 to 800ms band.
Under the media query the wipe becomes a 200ms fade.

directions.name: Brisk
directions.change: Cut the hold to 300 and the wipe to 500ms.

directions.name: Ceremonial
directions.change: Wipe from the center outward with a circle clip-path.

pitfalls: Showing the curtain on every route change turns a welcome into a delay.

tunables.name: --curtain-hold
tunables.effect: Milliseconds the curtain waits before wiping.

reducedMotion: The curtain fades out in 200ms with no clip movement.
